user.title: AV Companion
user.description: Select the display configured in LG Professional Display. Configure optional players and supply in Options.

error.invalid_display: Select a media player from LG Professional Display.

data.standby_signal_check: Check HDMI signal on the display
data.standby_idle_seconds: Idle fallback when signal is unknown (seconds; 0 disables)
data.notification_wake_display: Allow notifications/content to wake the display
data.sonos_select_tv_source: Select sound system TV input on explicit turn-on

data_description.standby_signal_check: Required for automatic shutdown when the linked player reports off/standby. Present or unknown HDMI signal prevents that shutdown.
data_description.standby_no_signal_seconds: Continuous signal loss before shutdown, including a player incorrectly stuck off. Default: 15 seconds. 0 disables this layer.
data_description.pip_no_signal_action: Applies only to persistent in-app PiP views. Temporary notifications remain protected. Requires LG Professional Display 2.33.0 or newer.
data_description.pip_no_signal_seconds: Continuous confirmed signal loss before the PiP action. Default: 15 seconds. Automation lock also blocks this action.
data_description.pip_no_signal_view: Used only for Show view without HDMI. Lists saved views with no HDMI element.
data_description.standby_notice_text: Up to 250 characters. {seconds} shows remaining seconds; {action} shows the planned action. A countdown is appended if omitted. Requires the connected display app.

error.invalid_pending_range: Value must be between 0 and 60 seconds
error.invalid_power_supply_off_delay_range: Power supply off delay must be between 0 and 300 seconds
error.invalid_standby_timeout: Signal loss: 0 or 5–86400 seconds; idle: 0 or 30–86400.
error.self_reference: Do not link an entity belonging to this integration.
